經甄選錄取獲得本校推薦資格之交換生，須依照所錄取之語言要求（JLPT、IELTS或TOEFL iBT），來遞交交換學校之交換入學申請文件。例如：以JLPT語言條件取得交換資格者，須申請該校之一般交換學生計畫（意即以日語授課之課程）；以IELTS或TOEFL iBT語言條件取得交換資格者，須申請該校之英語課程交換學生計畫（通常是國際學部專門開設給國際學生的英語授課課程）。

Graduate programs, and Cornell University degree/certificate programs outside Ithaca, NY are not open to university-wide exchanges.

not

not

Students entering Cornell
for a full academic or calendar year
are expected to maintain good academic standing. Good academic standing for incoming exchange and visiting students is defined as:
Earn a term GPA of 2.0 or higher in their first term at Cornell.
Successfully completing a minimum of 12 academic credits. To complete course credits, students must receive a letter grade of “D-” or higher, OR an “S” in a class taken S/U.
Failure to maintain good academic standing for your first term at Cornell will result in
dismissal
from the program.
All students are enrolled in
Cornell's Student Health Insurance
. This is mandatory and cannot be waived by international students unless they are covered by an acceptable U.S. employer-based health insurance plan.

We would like to firmly discourage students from applying for Working Holiday Visas. We understand that, since the significant increases to the price of student visas, the Working Holiday has become a popular option. Since May 2026, however, the Australia visa landscape has changed significantly students have experienced an unprecedented rate of visa refusals and delayed processing timelines that have led to the late cancellations of their program.
To minimise the risk of disruption to students' plans, we strongly recommend that students intending to study with us apply for the
Student Visa (Subclass 500)
rather than a Working Holiday Visa. Please refer to the
Australian Department of Home Affairs
website for the latest visa information and requirements.
